CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is Purworejo Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent as an element of the Regional Government administrator who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous Region.
3. Regent is the Regent of Purworejo.
4. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the Region.
5. Technical Regional Apparatus is the Regional Apparatus that administers government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection.
6. Village is a village and customary village or called by another name, hereinafter referred to as Village, is a legal community unit that has territorial boundaries authorized to regulate and manage government affairs, the interests of the local community based on community initiative, rights of origin, and or traditional rights that are recognized and respected in the government system of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia and located in Purworejo Regency.
7. Village Government is the Village Head or called by another name who is assisted by village apparatus as an element of Village Government administration.
8. Sub-district is part of the territory of the District as a District apparatus.
9. Female Victim is a woman who experiences suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, economically, socially, and other losses caused by violence, exploitation and/or gender-based discrimination whether occurring in the public sphere or in the sphere of personal life.
10. Child Victim is a person who is not yet 18 (eighteen) years old including a child still in the womb who experiences suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, economically, socially, and other losses caused by violence, exploitation and/or discrimination whether occurring in the public sphere or in the sphere of personal life.
11. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
12. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and worth, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
13. Discrimination is any restriction, harassment or exclusion either direct or indirect based on human differentiation on the basis of religion, ethnicity, race, ethnic group, social status, economic status, gender, language, political beliefs that result in reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of human rights and basic freedoms in life both individual and collective in the political, economic, legal, social, cultural fields and other aspects of life.
14. Violence is any act of abuse of physical force with or without using means, unlawfully and causing misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of freedom unlawfully.
15. Exploitation is an action with or without the victim's consent which includes but is not limited to prostitution, forced labor or Services, slavery or practices similar to slavery, oppression, extortion, utilization of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully transferring or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or utilizing the labor or ability of a person by another party to obtain benefits both material and immaterial.
16. Child Maltreatment is all forms of violence against children committed by those who should be responsible and/or those who have power over children, who should be trustworthy namely parents, close family, teachers, mentors, law enforcement officers, caregivers and companions.
17. Prevention is all efforts to prevent Discrimination, Violence, and Exploitation, as well as recurrence of occurrences against Women and Children.
18. Service is all efforts and actions to fulfill the rights of Female Victims and Child Victims of Discrimination, Violence, Exploitation, Child Maltreatment, and neglect which includes complaint Services, health, social rehabilitation, legal assistance and enforcement, repatriation, social reintegration, and restitution.
19. Assistance is all efforts and actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for self-strengthening of Female Victims and Child Victims of Discrimination, Violence, Exploitation, Child Maltreatment, and neglect of Women and Children to resolve problems faced so as to provide a sense of security and comfort and have readiness and/or ability to obtain Services and live their lives.
20. Assistant is a person or group or organization that is trusted and/or has skills and knowledge to assist Female Victims and Child Victims of Discrimination, Violence, and Exploitation with the aim that Female Victims and Child Victims feel safe and comfortable in accessing Services.
21. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a regional technical implementation unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for Female Victims and Child Victims of Discrimination, Violence, Exploitation, Maltreatment, neglect and other problems.
22. Forum for the Protection of Violence Victims hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK is a coordination forum for Prevention, handling and empowerment of Female Victims and Child Victims of Violence and other problems whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner and established at the Regional, District, and Village levels.
23. Integrated Service Center is a non-structural institution that coordinates the implementation of an integrated Service system for Female Victims and Child Victims.
24. Social Reintegration is all efforts to strengthen the readiness and ability of Female Victims and Child Victims to regain their welfare in social, political, economic, and cultural life with dignity, including strengthening acceptance and support into the family and/or community environment for the protection and fulfillment of the rights of Female Victims and Child Victims.
25. Restitution is compensation payment given to Female Victims, Child Victims and/or victims' families by the perpetrator based on a court decision that has permanent legal force for material and/or immaterial losses suffered by Female Victims, Child Victims and/or victims' families.
26. Legal Aid Provider is a legal aid institution or community organization that provides legal aid services based on laws and regulations.
27. Business World is a commercial organization, the entire industrial environment and production of goods/services, including State-Owned Enterprises, and Regional-Owned Enterprises as well as private or entrepreneurs and their networks, who will carry out their social responsibilities.
